description: Change the prices of one of your materials (price per gram, minimum job, failure surcharge, setup and post-processing fees, lead time). New quotes use them right away. Show the user the change before making it. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

min_job_price_usd.description: The least the shop is paid for one job in this material. null or 0 means uploaded model orders use the $5 default

price_per_gram_usd.description: For example 0.04 for 4 cents a gram

name: set_material_prices
title: Change material prices
